note_on_0_9: Draft 0.9 is on public main since cdae5cf. It specifies Appendix F; the reference checker implements part of it, and a construct it does not implement requires change as reserved, not implemented (W-RES-1, F.12). Theorems T42 to T56 are stated in Appendix F.9; T48, T51 and T53 are proved of models and the other twelve are unproved. T63 (exploration decides a law) is proved on the Form of RCE/Form.lean in RCE/Law.lean.
lean_audit_definition: The audit (scripts/lean-audit.sh, audit/Audit.lean, plus 6-kernel lake check --paranoid) counts every theorem constant in the kernel environment, including auxiliary equation/splitter constants the elaborator generates (5,393 under Lean 4.36.0 vs 5,537 under Lean 4.12.0 from the identical 1,264 theorem and lemma declarations written in source).
theorems_stated_unproved_in_0_9: T42 to T56 except T48, T51 and T53 (proved of models); also T60, and parts of T57, T59 and T61 (spec/book/10-theorems.md); T63 is proved on the Form of RCE/Form.lean (RCE/Law.lean)
